name: Unscripted
source:
Dive into the world of a wannabe writer and his friends trying to make it in Hollywood. Build deep friendships, go on hilarious adventures and fall in love. Make highly impactful choices and shape your story in one of the most ambitious visual novels ever created.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2156300/Unscripted/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
走进一位立志成为编剧的青年与他的朋友们的世界，看他们如何努力在好莱坞闯出一片天地。建立深厚的友谊，踏上令人捧腹的冒险，坠入爱河。在这部极具雄心的视觉小说中，作出影响深远的选择，塑造属于自己的故事。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2156300/Unscripted/]Steam[/url]]
